headline: Why do I feel destined to be alone?
note: Wired 2026-08-25 from fb-tarot/docs/drafts/shadow/REVIEW-money-alone-commit-2026-08-25.md — approved copy, transferred verbatim. Reuses the existing LONELINESS_TAROT_HOOKS frame; no new guard.

a: You turned the Magician. You couldn't see the cards, but your hand found the one with every possibility still out.
Look at his table. The cup, coin, blade and wand are all still there.
You asked why you feel destined to be alone. What catches me is that nothing on the table has been decided for him.
And yet you are alone, and the word “destined” has entered the question.
I keep coming back to something between your open life and connection. I don't think it began with you.
Let me look closer at what that is…
b: You turned the Hanged Man. The picture was hidden, yet you chose the one that's still growing.
Green leaves grow from the wood above the paused figure.
You asked why solitude feels like destiny. This card makes me look at the living growth inside the pause.
Still, you are alone, and the pause has become a question about destiny.
Something has hold of the solitude without announcing itself. I don't think this began with you.
Let me see what's holding this…
c: You turned the Fool. Nothing gave the card away, but your hand went to the one at the start of the road.
The small bundle on his stick is all he has packed.
You asked why you feel destined to be alone. This card brings me to the beginning rather than the end.
But no one is on the road with you, and the question has become one about destiny.
Something turns up just where a different beginning would open. I don't think it started with you.
Now let me look at what's behind it…
